# JUNO-TAO, arXiv:2610.23331v1, Fig. 28b: predicted POSITRON energy resolution sigma/E_rec after the data-driven
# correction, for the fiducial volumes R < 400 mm (red) and R < 800 mm (green), with the systematic band
# (green shading, drawn around the R < 800 mm curve).
# Extracted from the vector graphics in the PDF (page 33); axis calibration from the tick marks
# (x: 0-10 MeV reconstructed energy; y: 0.010-0.045).
#
# Columns:
#  E_rec_MeV   reconstructed energy (MeV); the curves are drawn from 0.55 to 10 MeV
#  R400        sigma/E for R < 400 mm (fraction, not percent)
#  R800        sigma/E for R < 800 mm  (the fiducial volume of the IBD analysis)
#  band_lo, band_hi   edges of the shaded uncertainty band
#
# Precision: the curves are stored as 50-51 points (dense at low energy, ~0.5 MeV apart above 7 MeV) and the
# band as 200 points per edge; values in between are interpolated linearly (a cubic spline in log E differs by
# < 2e-5). The R800 curve lies at the band centre to within 1.1e-4. Above 0.045 the band is clipped in the
# figure but complete in the PDF.
# The paper estimates the band from the difference between curves for different fiducial volumes; it is wide
# (about +-20-25% relative to R800), so it is a conservative uncertainty.
#
# Fits of Eq. (19) of the paper, sigma/E = sqrt((a/sqrt(E))^2 + b^2 + (c/E)^2) with E in MeV, to these tables
# (fit range 0.55-10 MeV; max relative deviation given):
#   R400     a = 0.02197  b = 0.00957  c = 0.01535   (max rel. dev. 0.05%)
#   R800     a = 0.02580  b = 0.01036  c = 0.01477   (max rel. dev. 0.04%)
#   band_lo  a = 0.02196  b = 0.00709  c = 0.01420   (max rel. dev. 0.03%)
#   band_hi  a = 0.02963  b = 0.01362  c = 0.01536   (max rel. dev. 0.03%)
#
